courseName: Master of Professional Supervision Practice MProfSupPrac

taught180Points.requirement: You must have completed a bachelors degree in a relevant subject. Relevant subjects may include counselling, education, health, or social and human services.
taught180Points.requirement2: You must have at least three years of relevant professional experience and be currently employed or volunteering in a relevant professional context. Relevant contexts may include health, counselling, education, social or human services.

taught180Points.requirement: If you have not met the requirement you can still gain entry if you have attained an equivalent and relevant, practical, professional or scholarly experience.
